title: Bayesian optimisation finds conditions for enzymatic site-selective acetylation of sugars
summary: Bayesian optimisation was used to find conditions for enzyme-catalysed, site-selective esterification of pyranoside derivatives, varying enzyme, solvent, acyl donor loading, time and temperature across eighteen substrates. The experimental data were used to evaluate yield-prediction models and warm-start approaches for unseen substrates. Products were applied in photocatalytic hydrogen atom transfer reactions to make ketodeoxy sugars. The abstract gives no numeric yields.
ai_technology: Bayesian optimisation over enzyme and reaction conditions, with yield prediction and warm-starting

evidence.tested: Experimental optimisation campaigns for eighteen substrates with measured yields and downstream use of products.
evidence.unknown: Numeric yields and the speed-up over conventional screening; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Bayesian optimisation proposed reaction conditions for each substrate.
